description: List child contracts and task/delivery orders placed under an IDV (Indefinite Delivery Vehicle) award. Each row includes the generated_unique_award_id to chain into usaspending_get_award for full detail. The award_id must be the generated_unique_award_id of the parent IDV — obtainable from usaspending_search_awards (generated_internal_id field) or from usaspending_get_award. IDV category awards returned by usaspending_get_award have child orders accessible via this tool.

award_id.description: Parent IDV generated_unique_award_id (e.g., CONT_IDV_NNK14MA74C_8000) — use generated_internal_id from usaspending_search_awards or generated_unique_award_id from usaspending_get_award

sort.description: Field to sort child awards by (e.g., obligated_amount, period_of_performance_start_date)

type.description: Type of child awards to list: child_awards = task/delivery orders, child_idvs = sub-IDVs, grandchild_awards = orders under sub-IDVs

name: usaspending_get_idv_awards

cap.description: The per-page limit that was applied, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether more pages of child awards may remain — set on a full page even when the upstream flag reports none.

notice.description: How to continue when truncated, or a recovery hint when results are empty — the award may have no children of the requested type. Absent otherwise.

page_metadata.description: Pagination metadata (no total count available from this endpoint)

has_next.description: Whether more child awards may remain — true on a full page even when the upstream flag reports none (this endpoint returns no total). A short or empty page marks the end.

parent_award_id.description: Parent IDV award ID whose children were listed

results.description: Child awards placed under this IDV

items.description: Child award record with ID, amounts, agencies, and performance dates

generated_unique_award_id.description: Generated unique award ID for this child award — pass to usaspending_get_award to fetch full details

last_date_to_order.description: Last date to place orders against this IDV (YYYY-MM-DD, nullable)

shown.description: Number of child awards returned on this page, when truncated.

truncated.description: True when the upstream reports more child awards beyond this page. Absent on a full page the upstream marks as last — has_next_page still says whether to request another.

title: Get IDV Child Awards
